shapeDefinitions.coreBendsOverFiveDegrees: turns over 5 degrees between hallway joins, matched guides
shapeDefinitions.guideBendsOverFiveDegrees: turns over 5 degrees on the complete guide, matched guides
shapeDefinitions.zigzagReversals: turn over 120 degrees with an adjacent leg of at most 2 m, complete guide
shapeDefinitions.approachOrJoinZigzagReversals: zigzag reversals on a terminal approach or at a hallway join
shapeDefinitions.coreZigzagReversals: zigzag reversals strictly inside the shared core
shapeDefinitions.approachElbows: terminal approaches with an intermediate vertex
shapeDefinitions.coreDeadEnds: degree-one vertices of the union of drawn shared cores per cell, all accepted guides
shapeDefinitions.arrivalStubEnds: core dead ends whose terminal is an arrival point
